specification.problem: Unstructured search over N items with a control-qubit-based modification of Tulsi's quantum search, with intermediate measurements of the control every few steps. The abstract states no explicit equations, so only background Grover/Tulsi-style relations and a small assumed instance can be given.
specification.reconstruction_scope: Smallest useful construction: standard Grover-type search iterate on an n-qubit data register (N=4, one marked item) with one control qubit measured every k steps (assumed), plus the success probability and a generic measurement-dephasing channel on the control. Tulsi's specific control-qubit construction, the paper's alternative angular parameter, MI and CCM correlation measures, and order estimates are outside scope.

symbols.meaning: angular parameter of the search rotation (paper's alternative choice unspecified)
number of steps between control measurements (time lapse)
joint state of data register and control qubit
projector onto control basis state c

equations.label: Standard Grover iterate
equations.description: Baseline search iterate that Tulsi-type algorithms modify.
equations.justification: Textbook Grover operator; not the paper's modified operator.

equations.label: Success probability
equations.description: Probability of measuring the marked item after t iterations without intermediate measurements.
equations.justification: Standard Grover result; the paper uses a different angular parameter choice, which is not given.

equations.label: Controlled step with control qubit
equations.description: Assumed generic control-qubit structure; Tulsi's actual construction is not reproduced.
equations.justification: Placeholder to make control-qubit measurement well-defined.
assumptions: Control initialized in |+> so that it acts as a control

equations.label: Intermediate control measurement
equations.description: Non-selective projective measurement of the control qubit every k steps, which dephases it.
equations.abstract_quote: search algorithm with intermediate measurements of the control
equations.justification: The abstract says the control is measured at intermediate times; the non-selective channel form is an inference.

equations.label: Total evolution
equations.description: Evolution with measurement every k steps; k=1 corresponds to measuring every step.
equations.justification: Composition of the assumed step and measurement; k divides T.
assumptions: \mathcal M is the channel in eq_4

registers.name: data
registers.role: search register holding the item index, computational-basis integer encoding

registers.name: control
registers.role: control qubit measured at intermediate times

steps.description: Prepare control and data registers in the initial state.
Apply the controlled search step U (assumed construction) k times.
Measure the control qubit non-selectively; repeat until T steps.
Evaluate marked-item probability p_t versus the unmeasured baseline.

specification.measurement: Intermediate computational-basis measurements of the control every k steps; final measurement of the data register in the computational basis.
specification.classical_postprocessing: Estimate success probability versus step count for several k and fit scaling of the required steps with N. Mutual Information and Cumulative Correlation Measure computation not specified.
assumptions: Tiny instance N=4, one marked item
Generic controlled-G structure replaces Tulsi's unspecified construction
missing_information: Tulsi's exact modified operator and control-qubit role
The paper's alternative angular parameter choice
Definitions of MI and CCM used
Order-estimation method and the time lapses studied
